candidates.lesson: Claims must be labelled by evidence boundary before acceptance.
candidates.after_answer: It is PROVEN_LAB only unless live invocation proof exists.
candidates.anti_apply: Do not mark runtime_ready from lab proof.
candidates.expected_use: Label future school outputs as lab proof unless live proof exists.

candidates.lesson: TargetAccepted changes quantity, not organ architecture.
candidates.before_answer: Build a separate validator for 50 then 1000.
candidates.after_answer: Use one runner and invariant validator with TargetAccepted parameter.
candidates.expected_use: Run same organ with TargetAccepted 5 or 30000 when allowed.

candidates.lesson: School acceleration starts with a bounded candidate feed supplied by owner or practice source.
candidates.anti_apply: Do not accept source-less generated atoms.
candidates.expected_use: Reject missing candidate fields before proof creation.

candidates.lesson: Accepted atoms need comprehension, before/after delta, causal link and retrieval/use proof.
candidates.after_answer: Only accept atom when improved answer uses the atom causally.
candidates.anti_apply: Do not pass count-only storage as intelligence.
candidates.expected_use: Validate each atom has improved=true and retrieval_used=true.

candidates.lesson: Atom/subchunk events roll up before map update.
candidates.before_answer: Update map for every accepted atom.
candidates.after_answer: Suppress atom/subchunk updates and update only rollup/capability artifacts.
candidates.anti_apply: Do not call positive self-map update in small proof.
